## Bounded defects — adjudicated, none silently fixed

P33.1's residual register and this run's re-check identified **two** real engineering findings,
both confirmed still-present and both left OPEN by contract (their repair shape is a maintainer
decision, not a mechanical fix — `db/AGENTS.md` forbids in-place edits of landed
deploy/revert/verify scripts; the defect is invisible to the per-change deploy/verify path
`make check`/`make test-db` exercise):

- `D-P32.10a-1` — whole-plan `sqitch verify` count defect: `db/verify/shared_temporal_contract.sql:30`
  asserts `count(*) = 27` watermark facets, but `db/deploy/publication_dispositions.sql` (landed
  later) adds the 28th `publication_disposition` facet. Owner: maintainer decision
  (count-derived / `>=` / stop pinning counts). Compensating control: per-change verify green.
- `D-P32.16a-1` — whole-plan `sqitch revert` PostGIS dependency: `db/revert/extensions.sql:7`
  drops `postgis` without `CASCADE` while `postgis_topology`/`postgis_tiger_geocoder` still
  depend on it in the postgis image. Owner: maintainer decision (CASCADE vs ordered drops vs
  new teardown change). Compensating control: per-change reverts green.

No other P33.3-scope engineering defect exists — P33.1 already repaired the stale
coverage-matrix verdicts and the deferral-parser blind spots; the four MISSING verdicts are
recorded deferrals/scheduled work, not engineering gaps.
